product_one_liner.value: Bizagi is a low-code process-orchestration platform that lets enterprise business and IT teams automate end-to-end workflows, build applications, integrate systems and embed governed AI.

pricing_page.notes: Public consumption-based pricing page; dollar prices are not published.

eng_blog.notes: The blog contains product, thought-leadership and tutorial content; the implementation-oriented candidates do not establish two engineer-authored posts about building Bizagi itself.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: AI-First Full Stack Developer (.NET / Angular / Azure); the mirrored posting was last seen on November 7, 2026. This is an AI-enabled software-engineering role, not a research/data-science position.

model_provider.value: OpenAI models delivered through Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service; documented AI Agent options include GPT-4o and GPT-3.5.

compliance_certs.notes: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 is explicitly certified; HIPAA and GDPR are stated compliance claims, not formal certifications. Azure-only SOC 2 and PCI DSS references are excluded.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest recorded round was September 13, 2017, before the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The readable current jobs board lists legal, marketing and accounting positions, not qualifying sales titles. Located BDR and AE postings explicitly show removal dates; remaining reposts do not establish live vacancies.

launched_6mo.notes: AI Advisor was announced on November 5, 2026, within the May 9–November 9, 2026 window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: CMO Samir Gulati left Bizagi in April 2026 and became HireVue CMO that month, within the November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Historical Bizagi job descriptions identify Marketo as its marketing automation platform and name LinkedIn Sales Navigator and Outreach as prospecting tools; these are stack signals, not confirmation of continued use in November 2026.
